verdicts.reason: A: the photo is cropped to a dark close-up of the robot's rim, so the product can't be recognised, and a leftover frame line floats in the middle of the canvas. The purple blob with 'Smart Home / GADGETS' is at least readable and sits at a sensible size on the left, with the rest of the banner taken up by murky photo. B makes the same cropping mistake, and on top of that the purple shape and its text shrink to a tiny corner badge, with 'Smart Home' barely legible. B also scatters two stray vertical lines and a dot grid through the middle with no purpose, so the headline has almost no presence.
